prompt: Research one AI infrastructure and power bottleneck investment idea.

inputs.seed_claim: Data-centre electricity demand is accelerating faster than grid, transformer, and turbine capacity, creating a multi-year backlog opportunity with high valuation risk.
inputs.drivers: AI adoption; data-centre build-outs; grid connection delays; transformer and gas-turbine shortages; utility capital expenditure.
inputs.value_chain: Grid equipment; gas turbines; electrical distribution; data-centre cooling and power.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed cites an IEA base case in which data-centre electricity use more than doubles by 2030 and current order and backlog growth at GEV and ETN.
inputs.invalidation: Efficiency gains, slower AI capital expenditure, permitting delays, or over-ordering could unwind backlog and compress valuation multiples.
